commands:
#!/bin/sh
# Re-execute each consumer's own documentation ratchets against GNATDOC-010 outputs.
# Usage: consumer_ratchets.sh CONSUMER_WORKSPACE OUT
set -u
W=$1; O=$2; mkdir -p "$O"
A=/tmp/gnatdoc002-acquisition; E=/tmp/gnatdoc007/exports
run() { name=$1; shift; "$@" > "$O/$name.txt" 2>&1; echo "$name rc=$? $(tail -n 1 "$O/$name.txt")"; }
run core-warnings python3 "$A/core/snapshot/scripts/compare_gnatdoc_warnings.py" "$A/core/snapshot/docs/gnatdoc-warning-baseline.txt" "$A/core/gnatdoc.log" --sources "$A/core/snapshot/src"
for n in imgproc geometry mel; do
  run "$n-warnings" python3 "$A/$n/snapshot/scripts/compare_gnatdoc_warnings.py" --fail-on-removed "$A/$n/snapshot/docs/gnatdoc-warning-baseline.txt" "$A/$n/gnatdoc.log"
done
for n in imgproc geometry; do
  run "$n-coverage" python3 "$E/$n/scripts/check_doc_coverage.py" --fail-on-removed "$E/$n/docs/gnatdoc-coverage-baseline.txt" "$W/$n/first/_site"
done
run imgproc008-coverage python3 "$E/imgproc/scripts/check_doc_coverage.py" --fail-on-removed "$E/imgproc/docs/gnatdoc-coverage-baseline.txt" "$W/imgproc008/first/_site"
run mel-coverage python3 "$A/mel/snapshot/scripts/check_doc_coverage.py" "$W/mel/first/_site" --root "$A/mel/snapshot" --report "$O/mel-coverage.json"
run mel-coverage-pristine python3 "$A/mel/snapshot/scripts/check_doc_coverage.py" "$W/mel/pristine" --root "$A/mel/snapshot" --report "$O/mel-coverage-pristine.json"
M=/tmp/gnatdoc002-integrity-mel/source
run mel-integrity sh -c "cd '$M' && git rev-parse HEAD && git status --short | wc -l && python3 scripts/check_doc_source_integrity.py && git status --short | wc -l"
geometry-coverage: Documentation coverage: 452/452 items (100.0%); 0 newly undocumented, 0 newly documented
imgproc-coverage: Documentation coverage: 1512/1512 items (100.0%); 0 newly undocumented, 0 newly documented
imgproc008-coverage: Documentation coverage: 1512/1512 items (100.0%); 0 newly undocumented, 0 newly documented
